points.reached by: Holding block, also reached by wdata_i ==> dm_controller [wdata_i].
points.reason: The process writes authenticated_q from wdata_i(0) under we_i and clears it on reset or enable_i=0, so the authentication state can be modified or made unavailable; no special override behavior is present.
Confidentiality is not an objective for this concept, and the direct assignment only forwards authenticated_q without independently allowing its modification or blocking.

When enable_i is low, the process clears authenticated_q and valid_o consequently deasserts, so changing this control can alter and block authentication availability; no special override behavior is present.

we_i selects the assignment of wdata_i(0) into authenticated_q, so asserting or suppressing the write can modify or prevent establishment of authentication and therefore valid_o; no special override behavior is present.
